name: Lofty Form
source:
Yakushiji Shion is the eldest son from the clan that punishes bad people. But after he assassinated Empire's shadow Kurobe Akiyoushi, it is regarded as a rebellion against the Empire. He gathers the clan and moves towards the North. Every day they are attacked by pursuers. At the same time he is chased by the girl Hiramatsu Yae who fell in love with Shion. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
药师寺紫苑是惩罚坏人的家族的长子。但他刺杀帝国影子黑部昭阳后，却被视为对帝国的反叛。他召集氏族，向北方进军。他们每天都会受到追赶者的袭击。与此同时，他被爱上紫苑的女孩平松八重追赶。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
